name: PEAK
description: PEAK is a clubbing night featuring DJ sets and concerts that celebrate hyper-digital culture. The event includes Hyperpop, EDM, Leftfield Bass, IDM, and electronic music.
longDescription:
PEAK is a clubbing night at Maus Hábitos, featuring DJ sets and concerts. The event focuses on hyper-digital culture, with music genres such as Hyperpop, EDM, Leftfield Bass, IDM, and electronic music.

The line-up includes PHASER (DJ), DJ SENTADA (DJ), and FALCONA (LIVE ACT). The event takes place on November 6, 2026, starting at 23:59.

Tickets are available at the door for €6. Maus Hábitos is located at R. de Passos Manuel, 178, 4º Piso.
